## famine — talking to Miguel
> YOU PICK [gq:open:take] 
YOU: "What do you think?"
NPC: "Tell you what — I've got theories. Most of them are just fear with better lighting."

> YOU PICK [dlg:help] 
YOU: "How can I help?"
NPC: "I haven't eaten right in days. I can't pull my weight like this. Anything you can spare, I'll make it stretch."

> YOU PICK [alive:thread:secret] 
YOU: "About their secret — that was Meera's thread. We never finished."
NPC: "Yeah... where were we with that."

> YOU PICK [alive:thread:want] 
YOU: "About that favor — we never finished."
NPC: "I just said — did you miss it?"

> YOU PICK [dlg:commit] 
YOU: "I'll do it."
NPC: "Thank you. I won't forget who fed me when it mattered."

> YOU PICK [recap] 
YOU: "Wait — what were we talking about?"
NPC: "Still on that favor."

> YOU PICK [goon] 
YOU: "And?"
NPC: "We're done for now. Not done-done. For now."

> YOU PICK [recap] 
(conversation ended by the engine)
